_readme: Documented, TEMPORARY acceptances for `npm audit --omit=dev`, consumed by
This file can ONLY silence the exact advisory IDs listed below. Any other
high or critical advisory still fails CI — that is the whole point, and it
is why the audit level was NOT relaxed and no --force downgrade was run.
Every entry MUST carry: the written basis for acceptance, the date it was
accepted, and an expiry. Past its expiry an entry still suppresses the
failure, but the gate prints a loud EXPIRED warning on every run so an
STANDING RULE: when a patched version lands (Dependabot will knock),
remove the entry in the SAME pull request that bumps the dependency.
